description: Defines classes, structs, and enums related to distributed reduction operations in PyTorch, including ReduceOp, supplementary data structures, and various options for distributed communication primitives.

classes.name: _SupplementBase
classes.description: Base class for supplementary data used by ReduceOps, supporting custom class holding.

classes.name: NCCLPreMulSumSupplement
classes.description: Supplementary data for NCCL PREMUL_SUM reduction, holding a scaling factor and tensor factor.

classes.name: ReduceOp
classes.description: Represents a reduction operation with optional supplementary data, supporting various reduction types like SUM, AVG, PRODUCT, etc.

classes.name: BroadcastOptions
classes.description: Options for broadcast communication, including root rank, timeout, and async flag.

classes.name: AllreduceOptions
classes.description: Options for allreduce operation, including reduction type, timeout, async flag, and optional sparse indices.

classes.name: AllreduceCoalescedOptions
classes.description: Extended options for coalesced allreduce, inheriting from AllreduceOptions.

classes.name: ReduceOptions
classes.description: Options for reduce operation, including reduction type, root rank, timeout, and async flag.

classes.name: AllgatherOptions
classes.description: Options for allgather operation, including timeout and async flag.

classes.name: GatherOptions
classes.description: Options for gather operation, including root rank, timeout, and async flag.

classes.name: ScatterOptions
classes.description: Options for scatter operation, including root rank, timeout, and async flag.

classes.name: ReduceScatterOptions
classes.description: Options for reduce-scatter operation, including reduction type, timeout, and async flag.

classes.name: AllToAllOptions
classes.description: Options for all-to-all operation, including timeout and async flag.

classes.name: BarrierOptions
classes.description: Options for barrier synchronization, including device IDs, timeout, device, and async flag.

classes.name: DistributedBackendOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for distributed backend, including store, group info, timeout, and global ranks.

methods.name: operator RedOpType()
methods.description: Converts ReduceOp to its enum RedOpType.

methods.name: operator==(const std::uint8_t)
methods.description: Checks equality between ReduceOp and a uint8_t value.

methods.name: operator==(const ReduceOp::RedOpType)
methods.description: Checks equality between ReduceOp and a RedOpType.

methods.name: operator==(const ReduceOp&)
methods.description: Checks equality between two ReduceOp instances.

methods.name: makeNCCLPreMulSum
methods.description: Factory function to create a ReduceOp with PREMUL_SUM type and associated supplement.

methods.name: isComplexViewAsRealAllowed
methods.description: Checks if complex view as real is allowed for a given ReduceOp.
